POST {key}/versions: non-UUID upload_id 20001 before any query; outside the lock only unknown / other key / other app 20001 [upload_id]; in one transaction INSERT platform_icons ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE of the mark row, then the upload_id lookup (an already saved upload answers its version 200 before the expiry and sanitized_confirmed checks, applies nothing else, writes no audit), then expiry, sanitized_confirmed, max(version)+1, INSERT ... RETURNING; upload_id UNIQUE conflict answers the holder; updated_* without revision bump; version_create audit in the same transaction. Scoped to app_id, admin entry only. Contract: the last two admin operations leave x-implementation planned, PNG side above 4096 px added to icon_format_invalid; generated files regenerated; request-check-plan test probes only unregistered routes (no planned admin routes left).
